title: Hangman’s return to the light
summary: After his destructive feud with Swerve, Page earns another world-title opportunity and confronts Moxley.

chapters.title: Hangman wins the Owen
chapters.result: Page defeats Ospreay in the men’s tournament final.
chapters.context: The victory earns him the world-title match at All In Texas.

chapters.title: Hangman becomes champion again
chapters.result: Page defeats Moxley in Texas Death.
chapters.context: His second world-title victory completes this redemption chapter.
